comment_de: Kanonische, handgepflegte Vollständigkeitsquelle der Spezifikation. CI prüft: Registry × vorhandene Schema-/Vektor-/expected-Dateien = vollständige Matrix. Diese Datei ist der Maßstab — nicht die vorhandenen Dateien.
comment_en: Canonical, hand-maintained completeness source of the specification. CI checks: registry × existing schema/vector/expected files = complete matrix. This file is the yardstick — not the files that happen to exist.

mono_delta_ms.comment: monotonic ms since previous entry; -1 = unknown (first entry after process start)

prev_hash.comment: entry_hash of previous entry; seq=1: 64 zeros

entry_hash.comment: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of the entry WITHOUT the entry_hash field

narrowed.comment: machine-readable form of the 1.8 rule below, bound to the entry's OWN spec_version (10.6 rule 3); the generated entry schema carries it as if/then

license_id.comment: licence commitment: from spec 1.8 it MUST be the lowercase hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the licence key (the value of cloud_messages.activation.license_commitment), exactly 64 characters [0-9a-f]; a GENESIS whose own spec_version is 1.8 or newer with any other value is FORMAT_ERROR (format spec 4.1, 10.6 rule 3). Up to 1.7 the content was undefined and the standard installation wrote the licence key in cleartext: for such a GENESIS the verifier prints a notice (no finding) and never the value

purpose_statement.comment: declared system purpose from onboarding; descriptive evidence for purpose-limitation tile

predecessor_chain.comment: emergency chain succession; null for a first chain

confidence.comment: recorded = captured by proxy; claimed = asserted by provider/import source

source_id.comment: import source identifier; null for proxy

source_ref.comment: id inside the source for idempotency

request_commitment.comment: HMAC-SHA-256(salt, request plaintext); salt stored with vault object

started_ts.comment: start of the window, inclusive, appliance wall clock; may lie before the last entry before the silence; after a crash no later than the capture safe point and the ts_captured of answered calls written but not durable (format spec 4.4, 8.7)

ended_ts.comment: end of the window, inclusive, appliance wall clock (format spec 4.4)

downtime_ms_estimate.comment: -1 = unknown; from ts_chained of the last surviving entry of the previous process to this RESTART, not from the start of a following GAP window (format spec 4.9, 8.7)

reason.comment: export (from spec 1.9): export seal - the running installation seals the chain for a verification package and the same writer continues it immediately with RESUME (format spec 4.10, 8.4, 8.6); a verifier up to 1.8 reports it as FORMAT_ERROR (closed enum, 10.6 rule 3)

sealed_entry_hash.comment: entry_hash of the SEAL entry this RESUME continues from

reference.comment: what is being decided; e.g. chain seq, case id

value_commitment.comment: commitment of new value where the value itself is sensitive

step_id.comment: onboarding step id for duration measurement

signature_by_old_key.comment: Ed25519 by old key over JCS({old_key_id,new_key_id,new_pubkey})

pdf_hash.comment: null when Chromium unavailable and only HTML was produced

payload_canonical.comment: the exact JCS bytes sent to the vendor, verbatim

tree_size.comment: number of leaves covered, i.e. all entries with seq < this entry's seq

prev_checkpoint_hash.comment: entry_hash of previous CHECKPOINT entry; 64 zeros for the first

signature.comment: Ed25519 by device key over JCS({chain_id,tree_size,merkle_root,prev_checkpoint_hash,key_id,ts}) with ts = ts_chained of this entry

checkpoint_seq.comment: seq of the CHECKPOINT the token attests

tsa_name.comment: authority as configured by the customer; informational

tsa_policy.comment: TSTInfo.policy OID; MUST equal the token

tsa_serial.comment: TSTInfo.serialNumber, lowercase hex; MUST equal the token (checked against the token, not by pattern)

tsa_ts.comment: TSTInfo.genTime; MUST equal the token to the second

token_base64.comment: DER TimeStampToken (RFC 3161), base64; DER MUST NOT exceed 16384 bytes

target_seq.comment: seq of the AI_CALL whose capture was cut

request_bytes_captured.comment: bytes of the request the capture (commitment, vault) covers

response_bytes_captured.comment: bytes of the response the capture covers

scope_from.comment: earliest ts_captured covered; unbounded: 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z (compared as a point in time)

scope_to.comment: latest ts_captured covered; unbounded: 9999-12-31T23:59:59.000Z (compared as a point in time)

truncate.de: Kürzen der Kette gegen verankerte Roots
truncate.en: truncating the chain against anchored roots

silent_gap.en: concealed silence without a covering GAP

MERKLE_INCONSISTENT.en: Merkle consistency between anchored roots violated

TIME_ANCHOR_INVALID.de: Zeitzeuge widerspricht dem Checkpoint oder ist gefälscht
TIME_ANCHOR_INVALID.en: time witness contradicts the checkpoint or is forged

CLOCK_ANOMALY.en: time contradiction without a chained CLOCK_JUMP

CONCEALED_SILENCE.de: Stille im Kettenverlauf ohne deckenden GAP/RESTART

MISSING_CHECKPOINT.de: kritischer Eintrag ohne unmittelbar folgenden Checkpoint
MISSING_CHECKPOINT.en: critical entry without an immediately following checkpoint

REPORT_MISMATCH.de: vorgelegter Bericht nicht in der Kette
REPORT_MISMATCH.en: presented report not in the chain

UNSEALED_END.en: chain ends without a seal: incomplete (section 8.6)

CONTENT_DELETED.en: content deleted per retention, chain intact

HOLD_VIOLATION.en: content deleted despite an active deletion hold (section 9.3)

TRAILING_SILENCE.en: chain ends before the freshness window

TIME_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED.de: Zeitzeuge vorhanden, seine Stelle aber nicht unabhängig belegt
TIME_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED.en: time witness present, its authority not independently established

RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED.de: Hersteller-Gegensignatur stimmig, ihr Schlüssel aber nicht durch einen Vertrauensanker des Prüfers belegt
RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED.en: vendor countersignature consistent, but its key is not established by a trust anchor of the auditor

SPEC_NEWER.de: Paket nutzt eine neuere Minor-Version der Spezifikation als der Verifier
SPEC_NEWER.en: package uses a newer minor version of the specification than the verifier

UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE.de: Eintragstyp dieser Verifier-Version unbekannt; Eintrag geprueft, Nutzlast nicht
UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE.en: entry type unknown to this verifier version; entry checked, payload not

UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_FIELD.de: Manifest-Feld dieser Verifier-Version unbekannt; angenommen und gemeldet, alle bekannten Prüfungen laufen weiter
UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_FIELD.en: manifest field unknown to this verifier version; accepted and reported, all known checks still run

license_commitment.comment: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the license key; the key itself never travels, is never chained and never exported (client decision 2026-09-03). The commitment is public (every verification package carries it) and proves nothing by itself: possession of the key is proven by license_proof

license_proof.comment: proof of possession of the license key (heartbeat spec 4.1): lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256 (RFC 2104) keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the license key over the ASCII bytes of device_pubkey (64 chars) immediately followed by appliance_id (36 chars), exactly as carried in this message (100 bytes, no separator). The server recomputes it with the stored key, compares in constant time and refuses a missing or different value with 403 license_proof_invalid before anything is registered, regardless of the declared spec_version. Reference values: spec/contract/license_proof.json

spec_version.comment: MAJOR.MINOR of the specification the appliance implements (format spec 10.6); the server accepts every MINOR of its own MAJOR and steers the anchor contract by it (heartbeat spec section 6/9)

activation.license_key_grammar_comment: grammar of the license key itself (heartbeat spec 4.1): at most 29 bytes, uppercase letters, digits and hyphen - never longer than an HMAC-SHA256 block (a longer key would be pre-hashed to exactly the public commitment) and never 64 lowercase hex (it would pass as a commitment into GENESIS); mirrored by the telemetry and the metaserver admin tool

heartbeat.comment: integers, enums and fixed-length hex only — no free-text field exists by construction

spec_version.comment: MAJOR.MINOR of the specification the appliance implements (format spec 10.6); the server accepts every MINOR of its own MAJOR and steers the anchor contract by it (heartbeat spec section 6/9)

anchor.comment: every 5 minutes; the appliance MUST attach consistency_proof (RFC 6962, from the chain's reference size to this tree_size) and the server accepts a grown tree only when the proof verifies; the reference size includes gap witnesses (heartbeat spec 9.2, from 1.8). From spec 1.9 the message contract of spec_version 1.0 without consistency_proof has ended: the server accepts no anchor without it, records nothing for a new chain_id of an appliance that already has a chain with B > 0 without a registered chain succession (409 chain_succession_required), and answers an anchor below B that matches a recorded root or no recorded root as 409 stale_anchor without a fork finding

consistency_proof.comment: since spec_version 1.1 (heartbeat spec section 6/9.2): from_tree_size = the chain's reference size, i.e. the largest tree_size the server countersigned or (from 1.8) recorded as a gap witness (0 = none yet, then hashes is empty); hashes = RFC 6962 consistency proof from from_tree_size to tree_size

cloud_statements.comment_de: Signierte Bescheide des Herstellers in Antworten auf Cloud-Nachrichten (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.4, §9.5, §9.8). Ein Bescheid reist im Antwort-Member license, eine Aktivierungsquittung im Antwort-Member activation_receipt, jeweils als Objekt aus statement (unsignierte Lesekopie, vom Empfänger zu ignorieren), statement_jcs, server_key_id und server_signature. Signiert sind allein die UTF-8-Bytes von statement_jcs (JCS, RFC 8785), mit dem Gegenzeichnungsschlüssel server_key_id. Ein Bescheid ist nur wirksam, wenn statement_jcs I-JSON und genau die JCS-Form seines Inhalts ist, die Member genau die hier genannten sind, der Schlüssel zu server_ts gültig ist, die Signatur trägt und license_commitment das eigene ist. Bescheide ändern nie die Aufzeichnung; Verifier werten sie nicht aus. Referenzwerte: spec/contract/.
cloud_statements.comment_en: Signed vendor statements in responses to cloud messages (heartbeat spec 9.4, 9.5, 9.8). A statement travels in the response member license, an activation receipt in the response member activation_receipt, each as an object of statement (unsigned reading copy, to be ignored by the recipient), statement_jcs, server_key_id and server_signature. Only the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs (JCS, RFC 8785) are signed, with the countersigning key server_key_id. A statement is effective only if statement_jcs is I-JSON and exactly the JCS form of its content, its members are exactly those listed here, the key is valid at server_ts, the signature holds and license_commitment is the recipient's own. Statements never change recording; verifiers do not evaluate them. Reference values: spec/contract/.

statement_jcs.comment: the statement in JCS form (RFC 8785); only these UTF-8 bytes are signed

server_key_id.comment: the vendor countersigning key (format spec 10.7 key_id grammar)

server_signature.comment: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs

license_statement.comment: in the 200 responses to activation and heartbeat (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.4); display only

countersigning.comment: true exactly when state is not expired; a contradiction makes the statement ineffective

updates.comment: entitlement to feature updates; in spec 1.8 equal to countersigning; security fixes do not depend on it (decision 2026-09-29)

valid_until.comment: null for a license without a term

grace_until.comment: null for a license without a term

anchor_refusal.comment: in the 403 license_expired response to anchor (heartbeat spec 9.5): the vendor checked this anchor (9.2 steps 1-4), stored it as a gap witness and does not countersign it. The appliance treats the 403 as a license lock only if the statement is effective, appliance_id is its own, chain_id/tree_size/merkle_root are exactly those of the anchor this request sent and server_ts is within 15 minutes of its clock. Not a countersignature: never chained as CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT

activation_receipt.comment: in every 200 answer to an activation (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.8, from 1.9): the registration of appliance_id with device_pubkey is held under license_commitment at server_ts; a statement of state, not bound to one request; required with the licence statement to accept a rebinding (4.1)

license_commitment.comment: the commitment the vendor holds this registration under at server_ts

anchor_history.comment: the signed anchor history of one chain (heartbeat spec 9.7, from spec 1.9): GET /v1/anchors?chain_id=<uuid>[&since_tree_size=n], no login, no personal data; every root the server recorded (countersigned, gap_witness) or received device-signed without accepting it (reported: heartbeat last_checkpoint, anchors answered with consistency_required). The auditor fetches it himself and passes every root recorded before the package was requested as an expected root (format spec 8.6, 10.8, 11.2)

predecessor.comment: registered chain succession: the predecessor chain and the tree_size handed over there

successor.comment: registered successor: its chain_id and the tree_size handed over from this chain (the end of this chain)

cloud_response_members.comment_de: Unsignierte Member von Antworten auf Cloud-Nachrichten (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.3). Sie sind Hinweise, keine Beweise: Die Appliance leitet aus ihnen keine Entscheidung ab, die Aufzeichnung, Kette oder Verankerung betrifft; ein Hinweis, der seinem Schema nicht entspricht, wird verworfen.
cloud_response_members.comment_en: Unsigned members of responses to cloud messages (heartbeat spec 9.3). They are notices, not evidence: the appliance derives from them no decision that concerns recording, the chain or anchoring; a notice that does not match its schema is discarded.

update.comment: heartbeat 200 member 'update' (from spec 1.9, request of lane B): announces an update bundle; unsigned; the bundle is installed only after its signature against the pinned update key holds, with the customer's consent and never as a downgrade (heartbeat spec 1, 9.3)

sha256.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle file; transport integrity only, not authenticity; since the addition of 2026-10-07 it names the amd64 bundle

update_arch.comment: heartbeat 200 member 'update_arch' (from spec 1.9, addition of 2026-10-07, request A14 of lanes B and C): SHA-256 of the bundle per architecture; present exactly when 'update' is and taken only together with it; a malformed one discards the whole notice; unsigned, transport integrity only; the updater fetches <source>/<version>/ledger-<version>-<architecture>.rbundle and nothing without its own architecture (heartbeat spec 1, 9.3)

amd64.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle for amd64 (x86_64)

arm64.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle for arm64 (aarch64)

duty_mapping.comment_de: Sprachregel verbindlich: jede Kachel sagt „unterstützt die Erfüllung“, nie „erfüllt“. Wo LEDGER keinen Beleg erzeugt, sagt die Kachel ehrlich „kein Beleg durch LEDGER“.
duty_mapping.comment_en: Binding language rule: every tile says 'supports fulfilment', never 'fulfils'. Where LEDGER produces no evidence, the tile honestly says 'no evidence produced by LEDGER'.

transparenzbelege.honest_limit_de: LEDGER belegt erzeugte Berichte und Aufruf-Metadaten; Endnutzer-Transparenz (Kennzeichnungspflichten) erzeugt LEDGER nicht.
transparenzbelege.honest_limit_en: LEDGER evidences issued reports and call metadata; it does not produce end-user transparency (labelling) itself.

zweckbindung.honest_limit_de: Belegt sind deklarierter Systemzweck (Genesis) und dessen Änderungen sowie Anbieter-/Modell-Konstanz; eine inhaltliche Zweckprüfung findet nicht statt.
zweckbindung.honest_limit_en: Evidenced are the declared system purpose (genesis), its changes, and provider/model constancy; no substantive purpose assessment takes place.

testvectors.comment: Each vector = directory spec/testvectors/<name>/ with package files + spec/testvectors/expected/<name>.json {exit_code, finding_classes:[...]} . Crypto-valid bytes are generated in P02 by the ledger vector generator and then frozen (hash pin in spec/testvectors/PINS.sha256). From spec 1.4 the expectations hold for the audit environment spec/testvectors/pruefer_herstellerwurzel.json (--vendor-root) and pruefer_herstellerschluessel.txt (--vendor-key): the vendor keys of a receipt are established by the auditor's anchors, not by the package (format spec 7.1, 10.7). From spec 1.6 (format spec 8.6) every vector that is not a format error is also judged on its chain end: all vectors frozen up to 1.5 end without a seal, like an export from a running installation, and are therefore incomplete (UNSEALED_END, exit 4). Their bytes are unchanged; only the expectation follows the released edition 1.6 (precedent: spec 1.1, format_unknown_event_type). The group 'end' holds the chain-end cases of edition 1.6. From spec 1.7 the group 'hold' holds the legal-hold cases (format spec 4.24, 9.3); its chains are sealed, so their verdict shows the hold rule alone. From spec 1.8 the group 'license' holds the licence-commitment cases (format spec 4.1): GENESIS.license_id is the commitment from the GENESIS entry's own spec_version 1.8 on, a 1.8 GENESIS with the key in cleartext is FORMAT_ERROR, and a GENESIS of 1.7 keeps its cleartext with a notice (no finding); its chains are sealed, so their verdict shows the licence rule alone. From spec 1.9 the group 'export' holds the export-seal cases (format spec 4.10, 8.4, 8.6); the covered late immediate checkpoint (8.2 conditions 3 and 4) extends 'gap' and 'tamper', and four clarifications both verifiers used to read differently (10.1 segment path and presented plaintexts, 2 integer range, 10.5 processing stages) extend 'tamper' and 'format'.

vendor_key_list.comment_de: Signierte Liste der Hersteller-Gegenzeichnungsschlüssel im Prüfpaket (Format-Spezifikation 10.7). Sie zählt nur, wenn ihre Signatur gegen eine Herstellerwurzel prüft, die der PRÜFER beibringt (7.1).
vendor_key_list.comment_en: Signed list of vendor countersigning keys in the verification package (format spec 10.7). It counts only if its signature verifies against a vendor root the AUDITOR supplies (7.1).
vendor_key_list.signed_bytes: JCS (RFC 8785) of the list object without its member signatur; Ed25519 by the root key named in signatur.wurzel_id
vendor_key_list.valid_at: gueltig_ab <= server_ts, and server_ts < gueltig_bis if present, and server_ts < widerrufen_ab if present
